subject: reasoning
question: Six friends, B, C, D, E, F and N, are sitting in a straight line, facing north. No one sits to the right of D. Only two people sit between D and B. Only one person sits between E and C. F sits third to the right of E. How many people sit between N and F?
solution:
Given: Six friends, B, C, D, E, F and N, are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

 
• No one sits to the right of D.
 
• Only two people sit between D and B.
 
• Only one person sits between E and C.
 
• F sits third to the right of E

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
